children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Revanth Babu Raavi, Harsha Thota, Vamsi Rampalli
Sigmainfo: Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury, Divya Mishra, Magesh R
Key Takeaways
The metrics tracker showed two partnership inquiries and highlighted unresolved lead source tracking for Sigma, prompting a follow-up with the server team.
New URLs for the Sigma landing pages are implemented along with finalized pages for ecommerce and fintech, and there is a plan to integrate additional Australia/NZ ecommerce development keywords.
An overview of blog quality metrics covering AI score, originality, and readability was provided, with a demo planned for Divya and Sonam to better understand the assessment process.
An SEO checklist for new web pages is to be developed by Magesh, paired with a content gap analysis for blog topics, and a follow-up meeting is scheduled to finalize these action items.
Google Ads performance was reviewed with plans to analyze the impact of shifting keyword match types and to integrate Zoho chat conversion events via coordination with the engineering team.

Complete the traffic source reporting and lead reporting once the leads are filled.
Update his task sheet by adding due dates for all action items.
Review and analyze the Google Ads performance after the new keyword changes (shift from broad to exact match) and schedule a follow‐up call if needed.

Current Workflow
Use of a metrics tracker and log file analysis for understanding lead sources and partnership inquiries.
Reliance on an Excel sheet integrated with IQ and Lend Foundry tracker to capture leads from chat, organic and ad channels.
Usage of Google Ads and Google Analytics to monitor ad spend, impressions, clicks, and conversions.
Pain Points
Pending analysis details from the log files with data not fully reflected on IQ.
The current traffic to the ecommerce main page may be impacted.
Conversion events from Zoho chat are not being passed to Google Ads, limiting ad optimization.
Inefficiencies Observed
Excel sheet entries are not syncing with IQ, causing data discrepancies.
Absence of a standardized SEO checklist for new web pages creating potential oversights.
Broad match keywords in Google Ads may be diluting campaign performance, pointing to a need for a switch to exact match.
Key Stakeholders
Shiresha Madhury leads the meeting and coordinates action items across teams.
Magesh R is responsible for handling technical issues, log file analysis, and ensuring conversion actions are captured.
Harsha Thota manages the metrics tracker, Google Ads analysis, and coordination of blog quality and SEO tasks.
Divya Mishra coordinates documentation and assists in refining SEO checklist and blog topic strategies.
Sonam Dahake is involved in scheduling calls and ensuring conversion event issues are escalated.
Tools / Systems Used
Metrics tracker and Lend Foundry tracker are used to record partnership inquiries, MQLs, and lead source data.
Semrush and internal AI scoring tools are utilized for blog quality, originality, and readability checks.
Zoho chat/CRM and tag manager integration is intended for capturing chat conversion events.
Google Ads and Google Analytics monitor ad spend, impressions, clicks, and conversions.
Root Causes Identified
Incomplete log file data and reduced information reflection on IQ hinder accurate technical analysis.
The separate iframe setup of Zoho chat prevents conversion events from reaching Google Ads.
Excessive use of broad match keywords is diluting ad performance effectiveness.
Proposed Improvements
Send finalized log file details directly to the server team for further analysis.
Implement enhanced lead source tracking for Sigma by updating the Excel integration with IQ.
Revamp landing pages for Australia and New Zealand by integrating new ecommerce development keywords and strip features on pillar pages.
Create an SEO checklist for all new web pages and integrate updated blog topics, including clinical ecommerce, to boost website traction.
Schedule a meeting with the Zoho team to enable conversion event tagging for chat interactions.
Impact
Revamped landing pages and integrated blog topics, including clinical ecommerce, should drive better website traction and case study visibility.
Better integration of Zoho chat conversions with Google Ads will allow Google to optimize traffic spending effectively.
Enhanced lead tracking and refined ad keyword strategies are expected to improve conversion rates and optimize ad spend.
Metrics
Blog quality metrics including AI score, originality, and readability are tracked using internal tools and Semrush.
Google Ads metrics include spending of approximately $5.06 with 1,200 impressions, 24 clicks, and one conversion.
Lead tracking recorded 10 chat leads, 9 organic leads, and 1 ad lead.
Website user data shows 895 users from direct channels and 234 from Google, totaling around 1,305 users.
Risk
Data discrepancies between Excel inputs and IQ reflection risk misinformed decision-making regarding lead source analysis.
Failure to capture conversion events from Zoho chat may limit Google Ads optimization and result in inaccurate lead tracking.
Delays in mobile performance improvements pose a risk to overall website user experience and load times.
Canada & Australia Development Opportunities
Plan to feature additional ecommerce development services for Australia and New Zealand by sharing a list of small ecommerce platforms in the dedicated sheet.
Clinical E-commerce Blog
Commitment to publish a blog on clinical ecommerce to interlink with the upcoming case study for improved web traction.
Conversion Tracking for Zoho Chat
Need to set up conversion event tracking for Zoho chat to pass conversion data to Google Ads by coordinating with the Zoho and engineering teams.
Dynamic Keyword Optimization
Ongoing analysis and adjustment of new keywords in Google Ads, shifting from broad to exact/phrase matches to improve CTR and conversion performance.
